responsibility: This file implements the non-SVE AArch64 builtin subsystem, especially the Advanced SIMD/NEON and miscellaneous architectural builtins that the front ends expose as target intrinsics. It owns the tables and type-qualifier metadata that describe builtin signatures, registers builtin declarations and associated types, expands calls into target RTL patterns or helper sequences, annotates memory and floating-point side effects, and provides special handling for target-specific builtins such as FP environment access and Memory Tagging intrinsics, including overloaded memtag builtin type resolution via aarch64_resolve_overloaded_builtin_general. In contrast to the separate SVE builtin framework, this file is the main semantic and expansion implementation for classic AArch64 builtins.
